Just addressing the "tech impaired." Data centers have very little to do with data. It's all about the compute power.
Musk built Colossus 1, the world's largest Data Center (a Compute Power Plant). He built it for his own use, but as he was completing Colossus 2, he pivoted. He realized, Compute is the new Oil, and demand for compute is just beginning. He leased out Colossus 1's compute power to Anthropic for 45 billion dollars. Colossus 2 is up and running. It is so huge, Musk uses it, but there was still enough Compute Power to lease part of it to Google for 1 billion dollars a month, not to mention Nvidia spending a billion dollars plus per year for a little space.
As we speak, Musk is building another huge compute facility he named Macrohardrr, a name that is nothing more than a middle finger to Microsoft. How convenient that he owns a Satellite launching company when he decided to start putting his compute power plants into space. A MILLION of them. No more screwing around with Democrats and the Data Center Panic Porn Purveyors.
